scope: Predeclared offline-only successor Meta challenger bank. It deliberately changes under-confidence target margin and training-query geometry while retaining the frozen P8U Router50/F72 Base, Current 75/25 blending authority, rich-policy outcome contract, MC1 gate, and portfolio rules. It has no live, exchange, admission, or promotion authority.

under.definition: strict-prequential unexpected favourable rich-policy residual, conditional on reaching the frozen 0.5-ATR trailing-activation level

candidate_bank.incumbent: under_bps100__timestamp with frozen Under-F120 LightGBM rank-XENDCG depth-4 sparse; it bypasses all proxy ranking and is carried into every confirmation.
structural_novelty: Unseen 75- and 125-bps under-confidence margins bracket the retained 100-bps target without changing the economic policy.
14- and 21-day Base-band block queries test calibration-state learning instead of timestamp-only ordering.
The two crossed arms test whether target margin and query semantics interact rather than assuming either effect is separable.
post_screen_feature_contracts: F120 plus the fixed three-field SHAP-stable additive overlay, only for shortlisted target/query arms; this is additive, never a replacement.
candidate_bank.post_screen_hpo: Only each shortlisted arm receives the fixed bounded LambdaRank geometry bank. Gain/truncation and regularisation are not tuned before the target/query funnel.
candidate_bank.selection: Use GateProxy_P0_Ridge for Top-3 new challengers plus one uncertain/diverse candidate. The incumbent is external and always confirmed. The challenger-relative proxy is intentionally not used until this new bank provides any qualifying positive incumbent-beat examples.

causality.feature_inputs: F72 target-free fields only during target/query screening. F120/F123 are used only in the later named post-screen stage.
causality.labels: Policy and supportive-path labels join only after held target-free scores persist and must resolve before the fold reserve.
causality.held_outcomes: Descriptor diagnostics only; never a score input.
causality.downstream: Separate strict-prequential Current and BCF MC1 maps, dual admission, and one chronological constrained portfolio remain the sole promotion evidence.
